caption: The drawing depicts a single cast iron cauldron with a rounded, bulbous body and a large, curved handle attached at two opposite points near the rim. The cauldron is shown from an overhead angle, with the body displaying a dark, mottled brown and rusty texture suggestive of age and use. The cauldron’s surface is marked by horizontal raised bands that wrap around its circumference, adding to its texture. The inside of the cauldron is shaded dark brown, giving a sense of depth, while the rim appears slightly lighter and worn. The background is plain and off-white, allowing the object to stand out clearly without any additional items or distractions. There is a small, faint signature or inscription in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Cast Iron Pot
